design: Two synthetic account blocks, three controlled fault placements, six fresh instances. During-final injection blocks the collector after the successful Redis check and before MongoDB. After-final injection occurs after every check completes.
policy: Approve iff all three final recorded checks verified. No injection labels, current container state or outcome enter the policy.
limits: Deterministically scheduled counterexamples, not naturally sampled races or fault incidence estimates. No concurrency-control treatment tested.
